name: enterprise-docs-organizer
description: Enterprise document organizer team: turns scattered company files into a categorized structure, a searchable knowledge base, an employee FAQ and operation manuals.

displayDescription.en: Organizes scattered company files into a categorized structure and a searchable knowledge base, then produces an employee FAQ and operation manuals so people stop asking the same questions.
displayDescription.zh: 把散乱的企业文件分类归档，沉淀为可检索知识库、FAQ 与操作手册，让员工不再为一个问题反复打扰同事。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我把这些散乱文件分类并建立目录结构
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me categorize these scattered files and build a folder structure

quickPrompts.en: Help me categorize these scattered files and build a folder structure
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把这些散乱文件分类并建立目录结构

quickPrompts.en: Generate an employee FAQ from these materials
quickPrompts.zh: 根据这些资料生成一份员工常见问题 FAQ

quickPrompts.en: Turn this process into a standard operation manual
quickPrompts.zh: 把这份流程整理成标准操作手册
